notes.title: Two new free levels are now available to explore!
notes.notes:
Greetings, fellow time travelers!

I, Professor Tim E., am pleased to announce the latest update to our beloved game, Cats in Time. With this update, players can now journey through two new and exciting locations: Ancient China and the Summer Beach. In these locations, you'll be able to save [b]20 new cats[/b] and find [b]six new postcards[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40306934/735461ac0c3cd78231240f4ca06a6c836eb59a8f.gif[/img]

In addition to these new features, we have also worked diligently to fix any bugs and issues that may have hindered players' experiences.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1599880/Cats_in_Time/

And the best part? Cats in Time is currently [b]20% off[/b] on Steam's winter sale! This makes it the purr-fect time to pick up the game for yourself or as a cute Christmas gift for the cat lover in your life.

We hope you enjoy this update to Cats in Time and we wish you happy holidays!
<3 Pine team 


PS: Our Escape Simulator is 25% off! 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1435790?utm_source=cit&utm_campaign=landing

notes.title: Cats in Time is now a part of Escape Simulator world!
notes.notes:
We are both delighted and overwhelmed to share the amazing news that we have officially sold more than [b]1 million copies of [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1599880/Cats_in_Time/?utm_source=landing&utm_campaign=ES_level]Escape Simulator[/url][/b]. We never anticipated our game to reach this amount of success and we are incredibly thankful for each and every one of you!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40306934/2431ca4ea9eece6d1678f092eff96e7d59f4b480.gif[/img]
To celebrate this very special occasion, we are glad to announce that as of today, you will be able to play through [b]a new official room[/b]! This new room pays tribute to our cutest game - [b]Cats In Time![/b]

[h2]Can you make it in time?[/h2]
[previewyoutube=dze1DmQFDg0;full][/previewyoutube]
In the new Cats In Time room, you will need to figure out how to repair Professor Tim Edger's time machine. However, this task won't be easy and you might just run into some strange issues while trying to fix the device. The clock's ticking! Will you be able to finish your task within thirty minutes? 😼

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1435790/Escape_Simulator/?utm_source=landing&utm_campaign=ES_level
To celebrate this milestone, both Cats In Time and Escape Simulator are 20% off on Steam. Don't miss out on these discounts and make sure to tell all of your friends! 😉

Pine Team <3

notes.title: Spooky season is here!
notes.notes:
Hello explorers! 
It's Halloween season in Cats in Time! Professor Tim E. just found a new location, and it's set in a spooky Victorian mansion. Be quick, and save 10 lost kitties! We also added a cool new badge. Good luck in finding it! 😉 
This Halloween level is part of the "[b]Seasons pack[/b]." We'll unlock 3 more levels in the next few months so stay tuned! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40306934/d13036068e2881e8471d00231c31711f5a86b62c.gif[/img]

Last week we had released our newest puzzler, Escape Simulator. Check it out here: 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1435790/Escape_Simulator/

Have fun!
[i]Pine team[/i]

notes.title: Small patch #2
notes.notes:
Meow everyone!
Cats in Time currently hold [b]100% positive ratings[/b] on Steam!! Thank you all for playing and taking your time to write a review; it means so much to us. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40306934/99d14282523b49d9cde3dd73075595333ebd84b5.jpg[/img]

In the meantime, we worked on multiple fixes and again fixed [b]ALL[/b] the reported bugs. Thank you all for reporting. 
You can see the complete changelog list here:
[list]
[*] Added better volume controls
[*] Added postcard zoom-in function
[*] We cut a few trees in New York
[*] Fixed missing sounds in Atlantis pack
[*] Fixed broken audio in Level 17
[*] Fixed the flag in Level 11
[*] Fixed the card bug in Level 23
[*] Increased the hook area in Level 10
[*] Fixed the broken hint in Level 28
[*] Fixed the kids mode in Level 2,12,15 and 22
[*] Fixed the small zoom area in Level 6
[*] "Secret puzzle" is now open when playing in Kids Mode
[*] Fixed the key bug in Level 22
[*] Fixed a few translations in Japanese (Thank you [i]hydro-guppy[JP][/i]), Chinese, Portuguese, and German. 
[/list]
Have fun exploring!
Pine team

notes.title: Cats in Time is out now! 😻
notes.notes:
It's finally time to play Cats in Time!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40306934/f1de16b344ea4c81d9e6de322a1abe4f0530c76a.gif[/img]

We have been making games together for 8 years, and "Cats in Time" is the first game we're self-funding and releasing without a publisher. It's not a huge game, but It's a huge stepping stone and a challenge for our team. We really appreciate every help and support from our incredible community, testers, family, and friends! ♥
And now play, solve, relax, share, help us save real cats, and don't forget to have fun!! 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1599880/Cats_in_Time/
-Pine team

notes.title: Relaxing chat with the developers about cats, puzzles, and time travel!
notes.notes:
We are so happy to announce that our Cats in Time is a part of Steam Next Fest, a multi-day celebration of upcoming games. You'll have a chance to try Cats in Time for the first time in our [b]new demo[/b]. It features 4 levels, set in 4 different locations/periods, and 40 lost kitties to find. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40306934/f1de16b344ea4c81d9e6de322a1abe4f0530c76a.gif[/img]

To celebrate, we'll [b]live stream today[/b] (June 16th). Join us while we search for lost cats, talk about development, and announce a few new levels and features that we are working on. 

PS. Don't forget to hit that [b]Wishlist [/b]button! ^._.^
